description: Source code for an OpenH264 video decoder implementation, including initialization, decoding, flushing, and error handling logic within the starboard shared namespace.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing video decoding using OpenH264, managing decoder lifecycle, input buffers, and output frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, stopping decoding and clearing resources.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the OpenH264 decoder instance.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the decoder instance and releases associated resources.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Schedules decoding of input video buffers.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer, handling key frames and configuration changes.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::FlushFrames
methods.description: Flushes remaining frames from the decoder buffer.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Processes a decoded frame, creating a video frame object and managing output queue.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream and triggers flushing of remaining frames.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream decoding and final output.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Creates or updates the decode target for rendering.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: VideoDecoder::ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error via callback, scheduling if called from a different thread.
